goal: Independently identify sudden steps and slow drift occurring in the same observation series even with correlated noise and impulse artifacts

calibration.observed: 240/240 on calibration after threshold choice; this is not independent holdout
calibration.progression: 2-window slope threshold .003 produced 237/240, robust bin median .003 produced 239/240, threshold .0027 produced 240/240

frozen_method.step: Search candidate boundaries 30..209, compare medians of 13 observations on each side, select maximum absolute difference if >1.50, report boundary k
frozen_method.drift: Median of pairwise slopes through ten-observation bin medians; if step exists take median of independent pre/post trend slopes excluding ±10 around step, otherwise whole series; label drift when |slope|>0.0027
frozen_method.noise: Autoregressive AR1 nuisance, rho=.35 or .72; uniform innovation ±.23; optional impulses ±7 at t42,87,173,211

evaluation.metric: Classification of both step-presence and drift-presence and localization of true step within ±8; each trace counts as pass only if both correct

limitations: Detector is offline/retrospective and examines all 240 observations; not online change-prediction
Synthetic noise family and known scenario kinds
Step is selected as one largest shift; multiple genuine steps are not identified
Same-person calibration, not independent external data
next: SG027 externally supplied data or unseen noise distribution/overlapping steps
